scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && pnpm site:build && sh scripts/package-source.sh
scripts.format: vp fmt src server tests packages apps/site/astro.config.mjs apps/site/package.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --write "apps/site/src/**/*.astro"
scripts.lint: vp lint --deny-warnings src server tests packages apps/site vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: vp fmt --check src server tests packages apps/site/astro.config.mjs apps/site/package.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --check "apps/site/src/**/*.astro"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
